data.title: About Valdet
bio: Meet Valdet, or Val for short.  He was born in Brooklyn, but moved to Old Bridge early in his life, where he was raised.  He’s currently in his last year of university, pursuing a computer science degree but don’t let that fool you, he’s got the time and drive to make sure you get the service you are looking for.  Val’s father is an owner of construction company and because of that, Val has been around real estate almost his whole life.  Making sure people are comfortable and happy in a home is something he is all too familiar with.

Also because of that computer science degree, Val is on top of the technology game.  With services, listings, emails and everything else involved in real estate moving to the tech field, you want to make sure you have someone who understand the lingo of the web.  One of Val’s other passions includes wrenching on cars in his free time.  He understands the headaches of something not going to plan and so with computer science and cars, he’s been able to develop an intricate skill for problem solving.  Val makes sure that the home listing/buying process is a smooth one for his clients and can handle a curveball if needed.
Let him be your advocate in your next home sale or purchase.  Call Valdet today at 732. 895. 2145!
